## Not Bugs — By Design
<!-- source: CLAUDE.md -->

| Behavior | Why |
|----------|-----|
| Skills don't execute code | Skills are instruction files, not programs |
| CodeDocs has no AI | Intentional — offline, deterministic, auditable |
| Zero external dependencies | Intentional — runs anywhere, air-gapped compatible |
| No package.json/requirements.txt | Intentional — nothing to install |
| Risk Score brutally low for projects with 0 tests | Intentional — Perplexity validated this approach |
| `_recommend_target()` gives opinionated recommendation | Intentional — neutral comparison was flagged as "generic" |
